comments: Registered as one bank on the bottom of the disc: the pivot x is the centre of the disc; every drawing fills its 96x96 box (95 px) and no drawing is scaled differently from another.
geometry: Tiles, footprints and every collision are the town map's (rules/moonfall/town.rs); art never sets a hitbox.
mapping_basis: Visual review of the delivered sheet and its measured crops, 2026-10-18. Six discs on a 3x2 grid in reading order = request order: far-0, near-0, close-0, falling-0, falling-1, turned-0. The crops are tight and separated.

pieces.label: far-0: half-lidded sulk, a small frown.
pieces.name: far-0

pieces.label: near-0: wide eyes, a four-tooth downturned grimace.
pieces.name: near-0

pieces.label: close-0: furrowed brows, a two-row jagged grin.
pieces.name: close-0

pieces.label: falling-0: a wide roar, upper and lower teeth.
pieces.name: falling-0

pieces.label: falling-1: furious slit eyes, a fanged snarl.
pieces.name: falling-1

pieces.label: turned-0: closed eyes, raised brows, a small smile; the disc is a cooler aqua-cream.
pieces.name: turned-0

size_basis: native canvas 96x96, anchor bottom-centre (48,96); a disc touching all four sides of its box; stage 384x224.
timing: far 12, near 12, close 12, falling 2 frames of 6, turned 12 ticks (30 Hz). Art never sets a hitbox.
